title: Kamishiro Rui — Evasive Entertainer〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui, Robo-Nene!
Thank you for joining our troupe☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's make every show of ours a fantastic one together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, without further ado, let's discuss what sort of production we should be doing for our next per—

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Before that, I have something to pass to Rui and Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is that...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes, this is a staff entry permit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We only accepted the job yesterday.
I didn't think we would be able to get our permits so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Looks like Mr. Mascot is very competent at his job. He doesn't make any unnecessary movements, too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm guessing he must be Emu's bodyguard?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for the quick work. This will be very helpful. I'll be sure to use it gratefully.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Is there something else?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. Before allowing you to use the permit, I would need you to agree to our condition first.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: We want you to tell us the route of entry you always took to sneak into the park.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's all?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: How do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I sneaked into the park and performed here without any sort of permission, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You may view me as part of the cast now, but I just can't believe that you wouldn't at least berate me a little for what I did.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I see what you mean now...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Please rest assured that as long as you reveal your route of entry to us, there will be no further repercussions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It is because Miss Emu needs you for her stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Needs me, huh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So they're really going to just let me off like that... It goes to show how much they treasure Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Very well. I'll tell you how I got in. I do need to show my appreciation for your generous acceptance, after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm going too!
I wanna see what Rui's secret pathway looks like too♪

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Then I'll join you...
I don't want to be left alone here with this guy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Say what?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Haha, she meant no offense.
She's just shy around people she's not familiar with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would a shy person even say such things?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, how about all four of us go together? You should be able to handle that, right?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Here you go.
This was the bypath that I used.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
Right next to Wonder Stage...
Talk about a blind spot.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I must seal this place up for Miss Emu's safety. Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: He left...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then! It's time for us to do what we actually came here for!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone, take a look at this!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: A notebook?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It contains the plan for our future shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plan?! As in plan your finances, right?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I don't think he meant that sort of plan...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I can see you've given this quite a bit of thought.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmph! I get work done, and quickly!
That's why I'm me!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hm... This is surprisingly deep planning coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need to mention you were surprised!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To pull out all the stops for a successful show is what we all ought to be doing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes... I agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's make this a great show together, Tsukasa.
